summary: Every operation is present with the correct press, shut height, stroke and the golden hole, slot, radius and emboss values, and the header revision and dates are right. It fails on the stage number ('PP-010 to PP-090'), and its rework tells the operator to reject burred or off-dimension parts instead of deburring or reprocessing them. It also adds many PPAP control-plan specs the golden does not have: extra dimensions (249, 25, 145, 12, 75 mm), sampling frequencies, form references, Piercing 2 press settings and RPO.
